local V = require 'CSV/Core'
local M = {}
M.metrics={requested=0,queued=0,active=0,blocked=0,failed=0}
M.history={}
local playing=setmetatable({}, {__mode='k'})
local recent = setmetatable({}, {__mode='k'})

local function hasShoutItem(player)
    local function special(item) return item and item:getShoutType() ~= nil end
    if special(player:getPrimaryHandItem()) or special(player:getSecondaryHandItem()) then return true end
    local worn = player:getWornItems()
    if worn then
        for i=0,worn:size()-1 do if special(worn:get(i):getItem()) then return true end end
    end
    return false
end

function M.call(player)
    if player and player.isDead and player:isDead() then return true end
    if not require('CSV/NativeVoice').ready(player) then return false end
    M.metrics.requested=M.metrics.requested+1
    if not require('CSV/VoiceOwnership').calloutAllowed(player) then M.metrics.blocked=M.metrics.blocked+1;return true end
    local sneaking = player:isSneaking()
    if not sneaking and hasShoutItem(player) then return false end
    if not player:isCanShout() then return true end
    local voice = V.voice(player)
    local bank = V.bank(voice)
    local pool = bank.native.replacements[sneaking and 'WhisperHey' or 'ShoutHey']
    if sneaking and (not pool or #pool == 0) then return false end
    local previous = recent[player]
    if previous and player:getEmitter():isPlaying(player:getDescriptor():getVoicePrefix()..'CSV'..previous) then M.metrics.blocked=M.metrics.blocked+1;return true end
    local candidates, fallback = {}, {}
    local prefs = V.client and V.client.preferences and V.client.preferences()
    local profanity = prefs and prefs.profanity == false and require('CSV/Profanity') or nil
    for _,id in ipairs(pool) do
        if not profanity or profanity.allowed(id,prefs,voice) then
            fallback[#fallback+1]=id
            if id ~= previous then candidates[#candidates+1]=id end
        end
    end
    if #candidates==0 then candidates=fallback end
    if #candidates==0 then M.metrics.blocked=M.metrics.blocked+1;return true end
    local id = candidates[ZombRand(#candidates)+1]
    local item = player:getPrimaryHandItem()
    local mega = item and item:hasTag(ItemTag.MEGAPHONE)
    local radius = sneaking and (mega and 18 or 6) or (mega and 90 or 30)
    local handle=player:transmitPlayerVoiceSound('CSV'..id)
    if not handle or handle==0 then M.metrics.failed=M.metrics.failed+1;return true end
    M.stopSpeech(player)
    recent[player] = id
    local entry={voice=V.voice(player),id=id,text=bank.lines[id],radius=radius,sneaking=sneaking,megaphone=mega==true,at=getTimestampMs(),handle=handle,state='queued'}
    M.history[#M.history+1]=entry
    if #M.history>32 then table.remove(M.history,1)end
    playing[player]=entry;M.metrics.queued=M.metrics.queued+1
    if V.client and V.client.captionsEnabled and V.client.captionsEnabled() then
        require('CSV/Caption').renderDebug(V.client,player,entry.id,radius)
        player:SayShout(entry.text)
    end
    addSound(player,player:getX(),player:getY(),player:getZ(),radius,radius)
    player:playEmote('shout')
    return true
end

function M.stopSpeech(player)
    require('CSV/VoiceOwnership').claimCallout(player)
end

function M.busy(player)
    if not player then return false end
    M.observe(player)
    if playing[player] then return true end
    if not require('CSV/NativeVoice').ready(player) then return false end
    local emitter=player:getEmitter();local prefix=player:getDescriptor():getVoicePrefix()
    if not emitter or not prefix then return false end
    -- Includes engine-owned calls, special shout items and remote characters.
    for _,suffix in ipairs({'ShoutHey','ShoutMegaphoneHey','WhisperHey','WhisperPsst','WhisperMegaphoneHey','WhisperMegaphonePsst'})do
        if emitter:isPlaying(prefix..suffix) then return true end
    end
    local native=V.bank(V.voice(player)).native
    for _,source in ipairs({'ShoutHey','WhisperHey'})do
        for _,id in ipairs(native.replacements[source] or {})do
            if emitter:isPlaying(prefix..'CSV'..id) then return true end
        end
    end
    return false
end

function M.interrupt(player)
    local entry=playing[player]
    if not entry then return end
    playing[player]=nil
    entry.state='interrupted_by_injury'
    local emitter=player:getEmitter()
    if emitter and emitter.stopSoundLocal then emitter:stopSoundLocal(entry.handle) end
end

function M.observe(player)
    local entry=playing[player]
    if not entry then return end
    if player.isDead and player:isDead() then M.interrupt(player);entry.state='actor_dead';return end
    if require('CSV/NativeVoice').painActive(player) then M.interrupt(player);return end
    local emitter=player:getEmitter()
    if not emitter then entry.state='emitter_unavailable';playing[player]=nil;return end
    local active=emitter:isPlaying(entry.handle)
    local pending=emitter.hasSoundsToStart and emitter:hasSoundsToStart()
    if active and not pending and not entry.started then
        entry.started=getTimestampMs();entry.state='engine_active';M.metrics.active=M.metrics.active+1
    elseif active and entry.started and getTimestampMs()-entry.started>=require('CSV/VoiceContract').maxClipMs then
        emitter:stopSoundLocal(entry.handle)
        entry.state='duration_limit';playing[player]=nil
    elseif not active and getTimestampMs()-entry.at>=250 then
        entry.state=entry.started and 'engine_finished' or 'ended_before_start';playing[player]=nil
    end
end

function M.export(writer)
    local m=M.metrics
    writer:write('VOICE_CALLOUT requested='..m.requested..' queued='..m.queued..' engineActive='..m.active..' blocked='..m.blocked..' failed='..m.failed..'\n')
    for _,entry in ipairs(M.history)do
        -- Kahlua's %q truncates non-ASCII characters, e.g. Turkish dotless i.
        local caption='"'..entry.text:gsub('\\','\\\\'):gsub('"','\\"'):gsub('\r','\\r'):gsub('\n','\\n')..'"'
        writer:write('VOICE_CALL voice='..tostring(entry.voice)..' line='..entry.id..' caption='..caption..' sneaking='..tostring(entry.sneaking)..' megaphone='..tostring(entry.megaphone)..' radius='..entry.radius..' at='..entry.at..' state='..entry.state..'\n')
    end
end

function M.install(menu)
    if menu.csvCalloutKeyInstalled then return end
    menu.csvCalloutKeyInstalled = true
    local emote=menu.emote
    menu.emote=function(self,name,...)
        if name=='shout' and require('CSV/NativeVoice').ready(self.character) and M.call(self.character) then
            self.character:setJoypadIgnoreAimUntilCentered(true);return
        end
        return emote(self,name,...)
    end
    local pressed, released = menu.onKeyPressed, menu.onKeyReleased
    local pending
    menu.onKeyPressed = function(key)
        if getCore():isKey(KeybindId.SHOUT,key) then
            pending=nil
            if menu.checkKey(key) and getCore():getGameMode()~='Tutorial' then
                local p=getSpecificPlayer(0)
                if require('CSV/NativeVoice').ready(p) and not p:getVehicle() then
                    pending={player=p,at=getTimestampMs(),closedRadial=getCore():getOptionRadialMenuKeyToggle() and getPlayerRadialMenu(0):isReallyVisible()}
                end
            end
        end
        return pressed(key)
    end
    menu.onKeyReleased = function(key)
        if not getCore():isKey(KeybindId.SHOUT,key) then return released(key) end
        local press=pending
        pending=nil
        local p=getSpecificPlayer(0)
        if press and p==press.player and require('CSV/NativeVoice').ready(p) and not p:getVehicle() then
            if menu.checkKey(key) and not press.closedRadial and not getPlayerRadialMenu(0):isReallyVisible() and getTimestampMs()-press.at<450 then
                if M.call(p) then return end
            end
        elseif not press and p and require('CSV/NativeVoice').ready(p) and not p:getVehicle() and getCore():getGameMode()~='Tutorial' and not getPlayerRadialMenu(0):isReallyVisible() then
            return
        end
        return released(key)
    end
end
return M

-- Traumatic injury evidence is independent of need recovery and speech cooldowns.
local I={players=setmetatable({},{__mode='k'}),sequence=0,context=setmetatable({},{__mode='k'})}
local call=require('CSV/Actors').call
local V=require 'CSV/Core'
local fields={bite='getBiteTime',scratch='getScratchTime',cut='getCutTime',deep='getDeepWoundTime',burn='getBurnTime',fracture='getFractureTime'}
local function finite(n)return type(n)=='number' and n==n and n~=math.huge and n~=-math.huge end
local function eligible(p)
 return p and call(p,'isLocalPlayer')==true and call(p,'isDead')==false and V.config.enabled and V.languageSupported() and V.extended(V.voice(p))
end
function I.snapshot(p)
 local body=call(p,'getBodyDamage');local parts=call(body,'getBodyParts');local count=call(parts,'size')
 if type(count)~='number' then return nil end
 local out={}
 for index=0,count-1 do
  local part=call(parts,'get',index);local row={bitten=call(part,'bitten'),health=call(part,'getHealth'),bleeding=call(part,'getBleedingTime'),stitched=call(part,'stitched')}
  for key,method in pairs(fields)do row[key]=call(part,method) end
  out[index]=row
 end
 return out
end
local function state(p)
 local s=I.players[p];if not s then s={budget=0};I.players[p]=s end;return s
end
local function loss(before,after)
 return finite(before) and finite(after) and after<before
end
function I.emit(p,kind,source,part)
 if not eligible(p) then return false end
 local s=state(p);local now=V.now()
 -- Several native notifications in one engine update describe one injury episode.
 if s.emittedAt==now then return false end
 if s.nativeWait then require('CSV/Trace').step(s.nativeWait.trace,'cancelled','newer_injury');s.nativeWait=nil end
 s.emittedAt=now;I.sequence=I.sequence+1
 require('CSV/TraitReactions').injury(p,kind,part)
 require('CSV/State').record(p,'physicalInjury');require('CSV/State').record(p,'acute')
 local trace=require('CSV/Trace')
 local t=trace.begin(p,'AcutePain',source,{acute=true})
 trace.step(t,'injury_confirmed',kind,{part=part,event=I.sequence})
 local native=require 'CSV/NativeVoice'
 if native.supported(V.voice(p)) and native.ready(p) then
  require('CSV/ProductionReport').observe(V.voice(p)..'_injury_detected_'..kind,{acute=true})
  trace.step(t,'delegated','await_native_'..V.voice(p)..'_pain')
  if native.painActive(p) then trace.step(t,'native_active','injury_audio_observed')
  else s.nativeWait={deadline=now+200,trace=t,sequence=I.sequence} end
  return true
 end
 return I.fallback(p,t,I.sequence)
end
function I.fallback(p,t,sequence)
 local trace=require 'CSV/Trace'
 trace.step(t,'fallback','native_pain_unavailable')
 require('CSV/VoiceOwnership').injury(p)
 local previous=I.context[p];I.context[p]=sequence
 local ok,err=pcall(trace.call,t,p,require('ConditionalSpeech_Core').generateSpeechFrom,p,'AcutePain',4,4,false,true)
 I.context[p]=previous
 if not ok then error(err)end
 return true
end
function I.observe(p,parts,now)
 if not eligible(p) then I.players[p]=nil;return end
 local s=state(p);now=now or V.now()
 if not parts then s.before=nil;s.pending=nil;s.lastAt=nil;return end
 local previous=s.before;local continuous=previous and s.lastAt and now-s.lastAt<=2000
 local kind,where
 if continuous then
  for index,row in pairs(parts)do
   local old=previous[index]
   if old then for name in pairs(fields)do
    local a,b=old[name],row[name]
    if finite(a) and finite(b) and b>0 and (name~='bite' or row.bitten==true) and not (old.stitched==true and row.stitched==false and (name=='scratch' or name=='deep')) then
     if b>a+0.00001 and (name~='deep' or a==0) then kind=name;where=index;break end
     -- Native bite healing is at most 0.0001 * multiplier per update.
     -- Twice that accumulated allowance plus float tolerance is conservative.
     if (name=='bite' or name=='scratch' or name=='cut') and s.clockKnown and a-b>(s.budget-(s.lastBudget or s.budget))*(name=='bite' and 0.0002 or 0.001)+0.001 and loss(old.health,row.health) then kind=name;where=index;break end
    end
   end end
   if kind then break end
  end
 end
 if s.pending then
  if now-s.pending.at<=1000 then
   for index,row in pairs(parts)do local old=s.pending.before[index]
    local chronic=not old or not finite(old.bleeding) or old.bleeding>0
    if old then for name in pairs(fields)do if not finite(old[name]) or old[name]>0 then chronic=true end end end
    if old and not chronic and loss(old.health,row.health) then kind=kind or 'weapon';where=where or index;break end
   end
  else require('CSV/ProductionReport').observe('injury_weapon_unconfirmed',{});s.pending=nil end
 end
 s.before=parts;s.lastAt=now;s.lastBudget=s.budget;s.clockKnown=nil
 if kind then
  s.pending=nil
  -- Direct post-damage callbacks already represented this snapshot's changes.
  if not s.directSinceSample then I.emit(p,kind,'body_injury_transition',where) end
 end
 s.directSinceSample=nil
end
function I.signal(p,kind,amount)
 if not eligible(p) or not finite(amount) or amount<=0 then return end
 local s=state(p)
 if kind=='WEAPONHIT' then
  -- Native callback is BEFORE hit validation/damage, including avoided hits.
  local before=I.snapshot(p)
  if before and not s.pending then s.pending={at=V.now(),before=before};require('CSV/ProductionReport').observe('injury_weapon_signal',{}) end
 elseif kind=='FALLDOWN' or kind=='CARHITDAMAGE' or kind=='CARCRASHDAMAGE' or kind=='FIRE' then
  if kind=='FIRE' and s.fireActive then return end
  if kind=='FIRE' then s.fireActive=true end
  s.directSinceSample=true
  I.emit(p,kind,'native_damage_applied')
 elseif s.pending then
  -- A simultaneous physiological/unknown damage source makes bare health loss ambiguous.
  s.pending=nil
 end
 -- Hunger, poison, infection, bleeding and unknown names are not trauma events.
end
function I.tick()
 local now=V.now();local multiplier=call(getGameTime and getGameTime(),'getMultiplier')
 for index=0,getNumActivePlayers()-1 do
  local p=getSpecificPlayer(index)
  if eligible(p) then
   local s=state(p)
   local wait=s.nativeWait
   if wait then
    local native=require 'CSV/NativeVoice'
    if native.painActive(p) then
     s.nativeWait=nil;require('CSV/Trace').step(wait.trace,'native_active','injury_audio_observed')
    elseif not native.ready(p) or now>=wait.deadline then
     s.nativeWait=nil;I.fallback(p,wait.trace,wait.sequence)
    end
   end
   local known=finite(multiplier) and multiplier>=0
   s.clockKnown=s.clockKnown~=false and known
   if known then s.budget=s.budget+multiplier end
   if call(p,'isOnFire')==false then s.fireActive=false end
   if not s.nextRead or now>=s.nextRead then
    s.nextRead=now+250;I.observe(p,I.snapshot(p),now)
   end
  elseif p then I.players[p]=nil end
 end
end
return I

local O={watch={},pending={},players=setmetatable({},{__mode='k'}),nextTick=0,hooks={}}
local V=require 'CSV/Core'
local S=require 'CSV/State'
local R=require 'CSV/OutcomeRules'
local function call(o,k,...)
 local ok,fn=pcall(function()return o and o[k]end)
 if ok and fn then local good,v=pcall(fn,o,...);if good then return v end end
end
O.call=call
local function eligible(p)
 return p and call(p,'isLocalPlayer')==true and call(p,'isDead')==false and V.config.enabled and V.extended(V.voice(p)) and require('CSV/Core').languageSupported()
end
function O.snapshot(kind,obj,p)
 if kind=='car_door' then
  local door=call(obj,'getDoor')
  return {open=call(door,'isOpen'),locked=call(door,'isLocked'),broken=call(door,'isLockBroken')}
 end
 if kind=='car_window_open' or kind=='car_window_smash' then
  local window=call(obj,'getWindow')
  return {open=call(window,'isOpen'),destroyed=call(window,'isDestroyed')}
 end
 if kind=='window' then return {open=call(obj,'IsOpen'),locked=call(obj,'isLocked')==true or call(obj,'isPermaLocked')==true,blocked=call(obj,'isBarricaded')==true,destroyed=call(obj,'isDestroyed')} end
 if kind=='routine' or kind=='shelter_thump' then return {} end
 if kind=='trait' then return require('CSV/TraitReactions').snapshot(p) end
 if kind=='darkness' then return require('CSV/Darkness').snapshot(p) end
 if kind=='vehicle_combat' then return {occupied=call(p,'getVehicle')==obj} end
 if kind:match('^vehicle_') then return require('CSV/Vehicles').snapshot(obj,p) end
 if kind=='swing' or kind=='gun' then return {condition=call(obj,'getCondition'),jammed=call(obj,'isJammed'),rounds=call(obj,'getCurrentAmmoCount'),perShot=call(obj,'getAmmoPerShoot'),hasChamber=call(obj,'haveChamber'),chamber=call(obj,'isRoundChambered'),spent=call(obj,'isSpentRoundChambered')}
 elseif kind=='bandage' then return {bandaged=call(obj,'bandaged')}
 elseif kind=='disinfect' then return {alcohol=call(obj,'getAlcoholLevel')}
 elseif kind=='door' then
  local blocked=call(obj,'isObstructed');local barricaded=call(obj,'isBarricaded')
  return {open=call(obj,'IsOpen'),locked=call(obj,'isLocked')==true or call(obj,'isLockedByKey')==true,blocked=blocked==true or barricaded==true}
 else return {running=call(obj,'isEngineRunning'),starting=call(obj,'isStarting'),battery=call(obj,'getBatteryCharge'),fuel=call(obj,'getRemainingFuelPercentage')} end
end
function O.begin(kind,p,obj)
 if not eligible(p) or not obj then return end
 local e={kind=kind,player=p,obj=obj,before=O.snapshot(kind,obj,p),at=V.now()}
 if kind=='car_door' or kind=='car_window_open' or kind=='car_window_smash' then
  local car=call(obj,'getVehicle');local x,y=call(car,'getX'),call(car,'getY')
  if type(x)=='number' and type(y)=='number' then e.offsetX=call(p,'getX')-x;e.offsetY=call(p,'getY')-y end
 end
 return e
end
function O.finish(e)
 if not e or e.cancelled or e.finished then return end
 if e.kind=='start' then e.sawStarting=O.snapshot('start',e.obj,e.player).starting==true end
 e.completed=true;e.finished=V.now();e.deadline=e.finished+(e.kind=='start' and 10000 or 5000);O.watch[#O.watch+1]=e
end
function O.queue(e,group)
 if e.consumed or e.queued then return false end
 local p=e.player;local s=O.players[p] or {last={}};O.players[p]=s
 local now=V.now();local gap=group=='FuelLow' and 300000 or group=='WeaponBroken' and 10000 or 45000
 if group~='ShelterThump' and not require('CSV/VehicleRules').groups[group] and s.last[group] and now-s.last[group]<gap then return false end
 for i=#O.pending,1,-1 do
  local q=O.pending[i]
  if q.player==p and q.group==group then
   if now>q.expires or not O.valid(q) then table.remove(O.pending,i) else return false end
  end
 end
 e.group=group;e.queued=now;e.expires=now+(group=='ShelterThump' and 3000 or group=='WeaponBroken' and 5000 or R.urgent(group) and 8000 or 20000);O.pending[#O.pending+1]=e
 require('CSV/ProductionReport').observe('outcome_queued',{outcomeKind=e.kind,outcomeGroup=group,outcomeNativeSound=e.nativeSound})
 return true
end
function O.valid(e)
 if e.consumed or e.cancelled then return false end
 local p=e.player;if not eligible(p) then return false end
 if e.kind=='shelter_thump' then
  local impact=require 'CSV/ShelterThump'
  return impact.near(p,e.x,e.y,e.z,e.north,impact.square)
 end
 if e.kind=='routine' and e.actionObject then
  local q=ISTimedActionQueue and ISTimedActionQueue.queues and ISTimedActionQueue.queues[p]
  return q and q.current==e.actionObject
 end
 if e.kind:match('^vehicle_') then return require('CSV/Vehicles').valid(e) end
 if e.kind=='gun' then return call(p,'getPrimaryHandItem')==e.obj end
 if e.kind=='start' or e.kind=='fuel' then return call(p,'getVehicle')==e.obj and call(e.obj,'isDriver',p)==true end
 if e.kind=='car_door' or e.kind=='car_window_open' or e.kind=='car_window_smash' then
  local car=call(e.obj,'getVehicle');local x,y=call(car,'getX'),call(car,'getY')
  if type(x)~='number' or type(y)~='number' then return false end
  -- Keep the attempted door's position relative to the vehicle, including long vans.
  local d=call(p,'DistTo',x+(e.offsetX or 0),y+(e.offsetY or 0))
  return type(d)=='number' and d<=3
 end
 if e.kind=='door' or e.kind=='window' then local d=call(p,'DistTo',call(e.obj,'getX'),call(e.obj,'getY'));return type(d)=='number' and d<=3 end
 return true
end
function O.update()
 local now=V.now()
 for i=#O.watch,1,-1 do
  local e=O.watch[i]
  if not O.valid(e) or e.cancelled or now>e.deadline then table.remove(O.watch,i)
  elseif now-e.finished>=250 then
   e.after=O.snapshot(e.kind,e.obj,e.player)

local V=require 'CSV/Core'
local T=require 'CSV/ShelterThump'
local seen=setmetatable({},{__mode='k'})

local function enqueue(p,x,y,z,north)
 if not V.config.enabled or not p or not p:isLocalPlayer() or not T.near(p,x,y,z,north,T.square) then return end
 local voice=V.voice(p)
 if not voice or not V.extended(voice) or not V.languageSupported() then return end

  x=x,y=y,z=z,north=north},'ShelterThump')
end

local function observe(x,y,z,radius,volume,source)

 if not ox then return end
 for i=0,getNumActivePlayers()-1 do enqueue(getSpecificPlayer(i),ox,oy,oz,north) end
end

local function receive(module,command,data)
 if module~='CSV' or command~='shelterThump' or type(data)~='table' then return end
 for i=0,getNumActivePlayers()-1 do
  local p=getSpecificPlayer(i)
  if p and p:getOnlineID()==data.playerId then enqueue(p,data.x,data.y,data.z,data.north);return end
 end
end

 require('CSV/Connections').install('shelter-thump',function(t)
  if Events.OnWorldSound then t:event(Events.OnWorldSound,observe) end
  if isClient() then t:event(Events.OnServerCommand,receive) end
 end)
end

local H={players=setmetatable({},{__mode='k'})}
function H.stage(health)
 if type(health)~='number' or health~=health or health<=0 then return 0 end
 return health<=10 and 2 or health<=25 and 1 or 0
end
function H.pending(p)local s=H.players[p];return s and s.pending end
function H.observe(p,f,now)
 local s=H.players[p] or {requested=0};H.players[p]=s
 if type(f.health)~='number' or f.health~=f.health then return end
 if f.health<=0 then s.pending=nil;return end
 if f.health>35 then
  s.safeSince=s.safeSince or now
  if now-s.safeSince>=10000 then s.requested=0;s.announced=0;s.pending=nil;s.retryAt=nil end
 else s.safeSince=nil end
 local stage=H.stage(f.health)
 if s.pending and (stage<s.pending.stage or now>s.pending.expires) then s.pending=nil;s.retryAt=now+1000 end
 if stage>(s.announced or 0) and (not s.pending or stage>s.pending.stage) and now>=(s.retryAt or 0) then
  s.requested=stage;s.pending={stage=stage,at=now,expires=now+15000}
  local T=require('CSV/Trace');local t=T.begin(p,'Injured','critical_health_threshold',f)
  T.step(t,'critical_health','threshold_crossed',{health=f.health,stage=stage})
  T.call(t,p,require('ConditionalSpeech_Core').generateSpeechFrom,p,'Injured',4,4,false,false)
 end
end
function H.valid(p,event,f)return H.pending(p)==event and H.stage(f.health)>=event.stage end
function H.accept(p,event)
 local s=H.players[p];if s and s.pending==event then s.pending=nil;s.announced=event.stage end
end
return H

P.groups['OnDusk']='routine'
P.groups.Threat='threat'
P.groups.AcutePain='physical'
P.groups.ReliefThreat='relief';P.groups.ReliefBleeding='relief';P.groups.ReliefEndurance='relief';P.groups.ReliefThirst='relief'
for group in pairs(require('CSV/RecoveryRules'))do P.groups[group]='relief' end

P.groups.Psychology='psychology';P.groups.Startle='startle'
function P.fireEmergency(s)
 return s.fire==true and require('CSV/CriticalHealth').stage(s.health)>0
end
function P.decide(group,intensity,s,prefs)
 s=s or {};prefs=prefs or {};local kind=P.groups[group]
 local function result(mode,reason,radius,priority,allowStealth)
  return {mode=mode,reason=reason,radius=radius,noiseRadius=radius,priority=priority or 1,allowStealth=allowStealth==true}
 end
 if not kind then return result('upstream','unmanaged_group') end
 if (group=='Panic' or group=='PanicCallback') and s.fire==true then
  if P.fireEmergency(s) then return result('spoken','on_fire',15,4,true) end
  return result('silent','fire_severity_unconfirmed')
 end
 if group=='AcutePain' and s.acute==true then return result('spoken','fresh_injury',8,4,true) end
 local concealment=require 'CSV/Concealment'
 if kind=='relief' and not require('CSV/Safety').settled(s) then return result('silent','recovery_wait_for_safety') end
 local critical=require('CSV/CriticalHealth').stage(s.health)
 if critical>0 then
  if group=='Injured' or group=='Bleeding' and (intensity or 0)>=3 then
   if s.sneaking==true and not concealment.active(s) then
    if (s.whisperRisk or 0)>0 then return result('silent','whisper_would_reveal') end
    if prefs.whisper and s.contextWhisperAvailable then return result('spoken','recorded_context_whisper',2,4,true) end
    return result('silent','concealment')
   end
   return result('spoken','critical_health',4,4)
  end
  if kind=='relief' or kind=='routine' or kind=='loot' or kind=='emotion' then return result('silent','critical_health_defer') end
 end
 if group=='ShelterThump' then
  if not s.outcome or not s.outcome.verified then return result('silent','unverified_shelter_impact') end
  if critical>0 or concealment.active(s) then return result('silent','active_attack_defer') end
  if s.sneaking==true then return result('silent','concealment') end
  if s.sneaking==false then return result('spoken','confirmed_shelter_thump',4,2) end
  return result('silent','unknown_concealment')
 end
 if group=='Startle' then
  if not s.nativeAlert then return result('silent','unverified_alert')end
  if concealment.active(s) then local d=result('spoken','native_alert_attack',6,3);d.engaged=true;return d end
  if s.sneaking==true then
   if (s.whisperRisk or 0)>0 then return result('silent','whisper_would_reveal')end
   if prefs.whisper and s.contextWhisperAvailable then return result('spoken','recorded_context_whisper',2,2,true)end
   return result('silent','concealment')
  end
  if s.sneaking~=false then return result('silent','unknown_concealment')end
  return result('spoken','native_alert',4,3)
 end
 -- Attack evidence overrides crouching, but does not permit irrelevant comments.
 if concealment.active(s) then
  if kind=='psychology' and s.psychology and s.psychology.verified==true and s.psychology.kind=='zombieKill' and s.sneaking==false and (s.directAttack or 0)==0 then
   local d=result('spoken','verified_kill',6,2);d.engaged=true;return d
  end
  local urgent=kind=='panic' or kind=='threat' or kind=='urgent' or kind=='physical' and (intensity or 0)>=3
   or kind=='psychology' and require('CSV/PsychologyRules').urgent(s.psychology)
  if urgent then
   local decision=result('spoken','active_attack',(s.panic or 0)>=3 and 12 or 6,3)
   decision.engaged=true;decision.delivery=(s.panic or 0)>=3 and 'frightened' or 'urgent'
   decision.noiseRadius=decision.radius;return decision
  end
  if not (group=='AcutePain' and s.acute or group=='Panic' and s.fire) then return result('silent','active_attack_defer')end
 end
 if concealment.open(s) then
  local standing={};for k,v in pairs(s)do standing[k]=v end;standing.sneaking=false
  local decision=P.decide(group,intensity,standing,prefs)
  if decision.mode=='spoken' then decision.radius=math.min(require('CSV/Hearing').quietRadius,decision.radius);decision.noiseRadius=decision.radius;decision.exposed=true;decision.reason='exposed_close_'..decision.reason end
  return decision
 end
 local evidence=require('CSV/ThreatEvidence').kind(s)
 if kind=='threat' or kind=='panic' then
  if evidence=='blocked' then return result('silent','no_active_threat_blocked') end
  if evidence=='unknown' and s.targeted~=nil then return result('silent','awaiting_threat_evidence') end
 end
 if s.sneaking==true and (s.whisperRisk or 0)>0 then return result('silent','whisper_would_reveal')end
 if kind=='psychology' then
  local R=require('CSV/PsychologyRules');local e=s.psychology
  if not R.pool(e,s) then return result('silent','unverified_psychology')end
  local danger=s.humanThreat==true or s.recentThreat==true or (s.near or 0)>0 or (s.visible or 0)>0
  if R.defer(e) and not require('CSV/Safety').settled(s) then return result('silent','aftermath_wait_for_safety')end
  if s.sneaking==true then
   if prefs.whisper and s.contextWhisperAvailable then return result('spoken','recorded_context_whisper',2,2,true)end
   return result('silent','concealment')
  end
  if s.sneaking~=false then return result('silent','unknown_concealment')end
  return result('spoken',e.kind=='zombieKill' and 'verified_kill' or 'verified_psychology',R.urgent(e) and 8 or 4,R.urgent(e) and 3 or e.kind=='zombieKill' and 2 or 1)
 end
 if (kind=='loot' or group=='FoundLoot') and not require('CSV/LootRules').allowed(group,prefs) then return result('silent','loot_option_disabled') end
 if kind=='loot' and (s.near~=0 or s.visible~=0 or s.recentThreat~=false) then return result('silent','loot_wait_for_safety') end
 -- Actual fire and fresh physical damage may cause an involuntary cry even while crouched.
 if s.sneaking==true then
  if prefs.whisper and s.whisperAvailable and (kind=='threat' or kind=='panic') and (s.near or 0)>0 then
   return result('spoken','recorded_whisper',2,2,true)
  end
  if prefs.whisper and s.contextWhisperAvailable then
   if (s.attacking or 0)>0 and kind~='physical' and kind~='urgent' and kind~='panic' then return result('silent','active_attack_defer') end
   return result('spoken','recorded_context_whisper',2,kind=='urgent' and 2 or 1,true)
  end
  return result('silent','concealment')
 end
 if s.sneaking~=false then return result('upstream','unknown_concealment') end
 local near=s.accessibleNear or s.near
 local close=type(near)=='number' and near>0 or (s.exposedNpc or 0)+(s.exposedPlayer or 0)>0
 local danger=s.humanThreat==true or (s.near or 0)>0 or (s.visible or 0)>0 or s.recentThreat==true
 if evidence=='attacking' then close=true end
 if (kind=='threat' or kind=='panic') and evidence=='observed_only' then
  if kind=='threat' and evidence=='observed_only' and (s.panic or 0)<3 then return result('spoken','observed_calm_warning',4,2) end
  return result('silent','no_active_threat_'..evidence)
 end
 if group=='Threat' then
  if close and type(s.panic)=='number' and s.panic<3 then
   return result('spoken',s.panic==0 and 'controlled_warning' or 'tense_warning',s.panic==0 and 6 or 8,2)
  end
  return result('silent','no_controlled_close_threat')
 end
 if kind=='panic' and close and type(s.panic)=='number' and s.panic>=3 then return result('spoken','close_threat_high_panic',15,3) end
 if close and kind=='panic' and type(s.panic)=='number' and s.panic>0 then return result('spoken','tense_warning',8,2) end
 if close and kind=='urgent' then return result('spoken','immediate_problem',8,3) end
 if close and kind=='physical' and (intensity or 0)>=3 then return result('spoken','severe_physical_problem',8,3) end
 -- A verified firearm fault matters even if threats are farther than six tiles.
 -- Stealth, attack priority and unknown concealment have already been resolved.
 if group=='GunJammed' and s.jammed==true or group=='OutOfAmmo' and s.empty==true then
  return result('spoken','verified_firearm_problem',4,2)
 end
 if group=='TraitFumble' and (s.attacking or 0)==0 and not s.fire then return result('spoken','verified_transfer_pressure',4,2) end
 if kind=='relief' then
  if not require('CSV/Safety').settled(s) then return result('silent','recovery_wait_for_safety') end
  return result('spoken','verified_relief',4,1)
 end
 if danger then return result('silent','danger_defer_'..kind) end
 if require('CSV/OutcomeRules').urgent(group) and s.near==0 and s.visible==0 and s.recentThreat==false then return result('spoken',group=='WeaponBroken' and 'verified_weapon_break' or 'verified_vehicle_problem',6,2) end
 if kind=='loot' then return result('spoken','useful_loot',4,1) end
 if kind=='outcome' then return result('spoken','verified_action_result',4,1) end
 if kind=='relief' then return result('spoken','verified_relief',4,1) end
 if prefs.safeSpeech and s.near==0 and s.visible==0 and s.recentThreat==false then
  return result('spoken','safe_comment',4,1)
 end
 return result('upstream','source_mood_filters')
end
return P

local M=require('CSV/Pack').expressions
local indexes=setmetatable({},{__mode='k'})
local function index(bank)
 if indexes[bank] then return indexes[bank] end
 local result={sources={},groups={}}
 for _,entry in pairs(bank.catalog)do
  -- Older banks store the original profile name. Keep their slot IDs valid.
  local profile=({slurred='drunk',congested='ill'})[entry.profile] or entry.profile
  local source=result.sources[entry.source] or {};result.sources[entry.source]=source;source[profile]=entry
  if entry.groupFallback then
   local group=result.groups[entry.group] or {};result.groups[entry.group]=group
   local pool=group[profile] or {};group[profile]=pool;pool[#pool+1]=entry
  end
 end
 indexes[bank]=result
 return result
end
function M.pick(V,voice,line,facts,forced,player)
 if not M.approved or not V.extended(voice) or not line then return line end
 local bank=V.bank and V.bank(voice).expressions or M
 if not bank.approved then return line end
 local routes=index(bank)
 local options=routes.sources[line.id] or {};local fallback=routes.groups[line.group] or {}
 local f=facts or {};if f.sneaking==true and not require('CSV/Concealment').open(f) and not require('CSV/Concealment').active(f) and not forced then return line end
 local levels=f.levels or {};local choices={}
 local controlledFault=(line.group=='GunJammed' or line.group=='OutOfAmmo') and require('CSV/Traits').prefersControlledSpeech(f)
 if forced then choices[1]=forced
 else
  if require('CSV/Concealment').active(f) and line.group=='ThreatTense' then choices[#choices+1]='frightened' end
  if (f.panic or 0)>=3 and (f.near or 0)==0 and not require('CSV/Concealment').active(f) and (line.group=='Panic' or line.group=='Agoraphobic' or line.group=='Claustrophobic') then choices[#choices+1]='stammer' end
  if not controlledFault and (f.panic or 0)>=3 and (require('CSV/Concealment').active(f) or ((f.near or 0)>0 and f.reactiveNear~=0) or line.group=='Agoraphobic' or line.group=='Claustrophobic') then choices[#choices+1]='frightened' end
  if (f.endurance or 0)>=2 then choices[#choices+1]='breathless' end
  if (f.anger or levels.Angry or 0)>=2 then choices[#choices+1]='angry' end
  if (f.unhappy or levels.Unhappy or 0)>=3 then choices[#choices+1]='sad' end
  if (f.heat or levels.Hyperthermia or 0)>=2 then choices[#choices+1]='stammer' end
  if (f.drunk or levels.Drunk or 0)>=2 then choices[#choices+1]='drunk' end
  if (f.coldSymptoms or levels.HasACold or 0)>=1 then choices[#choices+1]='ill' end
 end
 local history=player and V.client and V.client.history[player] or {}
 local hurried=(f.directAttack or 0)>0 or (f.activePursuit or 0)>0 or (f.endurance or 0)>=3
 local function earlier(a,b)
  if hurried then
   local ac,bc=V.clip(voice,a.id),V.clip(voice,b.id)
   if ac.duration~=bc.duration then return ac.duration<bc.duration end
  end
  return a.id<b.id
 end
 for _,profile in ipairs(choices)do
  local entry=options[profile]
  if entry and V.clip(voice,entry.id) and (forced or require('CSV/SemanticSpeech').allowed(entry,f)) then return entry end
  -- Raw previews never silently substitute a different sentence.
  if not forced then
   local best,stamp
   for _,candidate in ipairs(fallback[profile] or {})do
    local used=history[candidate.id] or 0
    if V.clip(voice,candidate.id) and require('CSV/SemanticSpeech').allowed(candidate,f) and not require('CSV/SemanticSpeech').recent(history,candidate,getTimestampMs()) and (not best or used<stamp or (used==stamp and earlier(candidate,best))) then best=candidate;stamp=used end
   end
   if best then return best end
  end
 end
 return line
end
function M.source(id)if not M.approved then return nil end;local e=M.catalog[id];return e and e.source end
return M

local K={}
function K.distressed(f)
 local contact=(f.directAttack or 0)>0
 return (f.panic or 0)>=3 or type(f.health)=='number' and f.health<=35
  or contact and ((f.endurance or 0)>=3 or (f.pain or 0)>=3 or (f.bleeding or 0)>=2)
end
function K.dark(f,experience)
 local t=f.traits or {}
 return f.recentDistress~=true and experience=='practiced' and t.desensitized==true and (f.panic or 0)<=1
  and (f.unhappy or 0)<2 and (f.endurance or 0)<2 and (f.health or 0)>65 and not K.distressed(f)
end
function K.angry(f)return (f.anger or 0)>=2 and not K.distressed(f)end
function K.pool(f,experience)
 if K.distressed(f) then return 'KillDesperate' end
 if (f.traits or {}).pacifist and f.near==0 and f.visible==0 and not f.humanThreat then return 'TraitReluctant' end
 if K.angry(f) then return 'KillAngry' end
 if (f.unhappy or 0)>=3 or (f.traits or {}).cowardly and (f.panic or 0)>0 or (f.traits or {}).hemophobic and (f.bleeding or 0)>0 then return 'KillUneasy' end
 if K.dark(f,experience) then return 'KillDark' end
 if experience=='practiced' or (f.traits or {}).desensitized or (f.traits or {}).brave and (f.near or 0)>0 then return 'KillControlled' end
 return 'KillUneasy'
end
function K.allowed(id,f)
 if id:match('^KillAngry_') then return K.angry(f)end
 if id:match('^KillDark_') then return K.dark(f,f.psychology and f.psychology.experience)end
 local countIndex=tonumber(id:match('^KillCount_(%d+)$'))
 if countIndex then
  local e=f.psychology
  return e and e.kind=='zombieKill' and e.verified==true and f.zombieKills==({31,50,100,200})[countIndex]
   and not f.sneaking and not K.distressed(f) and (f.panic or 0)<=1 and (f.unhappy or 0)<2
   and (e.experience=='practiced' or (f.traits or {}).desensitized==true)
 end
 if id=='Kill_2' or id:match('^KillDesperate_') then
  if not K.distressed(f) then return false end
 end
 if id=='Kill_3' then return f.acute==true end
 if id=='KillControlled_1' or id=='KillDesperate_4' or id=='KillDesperate_5' then
  return (f.near or 0)>=2 or (f.visible or 0)>=2
 end
 return true
end
function K.choose(C,V,player,voice,f,experience)
 if not V.extended(voice) or not require('CSV/Extras').approved then return nil end
 local pool=K.pool(f,experience or require('CSV/Experience').level(player,'zombie'))
 -- Existing quiet takes remain available without turning concealed kills into shouts.
 if f.sneaking then
  if pool=='TraitReluctant' then
   local line=C.extraLine(player,voice,pool);if line then return line end
  end
  local id=pool=='KillDesperate' and 'Kill_2' or 'Kill_1'
  local data=V.bank(voice).data
  for _,line in ipairs(data.groups.Kill or {})do if line.id==id and V.clip(voice,id) and K.allowed(id,f) then return line end end
  return nil
 end
 local milestone=C.extraLine(player,voice,'KillCount',function(id)return K.allowed(id,f)end)
 if milestone and not require('CSV/SemanticSpeech').recent(C.history[player] or {},milestone,V.now()) then return milestone end
 local line=C.extraLine(player,voice,pool,function(id)return K.allowed(id,f)end)
 if pool=='KillDark' or pool=='KillAngry' then
  local semantic=require('CSV/SemanticSpeech');local h=C.history[player] or {}
  if not line or semantic.recent(h,line,V.now()) then
   local fallback=C.extraLine(player,voice,'KillControlled',function(id)return K.allowed(id,f)end)
   if fallback and (not line or semantic.stamp(h,fallback)<semantic.stamp(h,line))then line=fallback end
  end
 end
 if pool=='KillControlled' and require('CSV/Traits').dryCoping(f) then
  local dry=C.extraLine(player,voice,'DryCoping');local semantic=require 'CSV/SemanticSpeech'
  local history=C.history[player] or {}
  if dry and (not line or semantic.stamp(history,dry)<semantic.stamp(history,line)) then line=dry end
 end
 -- Pleading is a distressed fallback, after the broader set has been used.
 if pool=='KillDesperate' then
  local history=C.history[player] or {};local semantic=require 'CSV/SemanticSpeech'
  for _,legacy in ipairs(V.bank(voice).data.groups.Kill or {})do
   if legacy.id=='Kill_2' and K.allowed(legacy.id,f) and (not line or semantic.stamp(history,legacy)<semantic.stamp(history,line)) then line=legacy end
  end
 end
 return line
end
return K

local L={groups={LootWeapon=true,LootFood=true,LootBandage=true,LootPainMedicine=true,LootStomach=true,LootAmmo=true,LootWater=true,LootLight=true,LootClothing=true,LootCanOpener=true,LootMagazine=true}}
L.gaps={[0]={between=90000,category=600000},[1]={between=30000,category=180000},[2]={between=10000,category=60000}}
function L.settings(prefs)
 prefs=prefs or {};local mode=prefs.lootMode;local frequency=prefs.lootFrequency
 if mode~=0 and mode~=1 and mode~=2 then mode=2 end
 return mode,L.gaps[frequency] or L.gaps[1]
end
function L.allowed(group,prefs)
 local mode=L.settings(prefs)
 return mode~=0 and (mode==2 or group~='LootWeapon' and group~='FoundLoot')
end
-- Pure facts: absent/unknown item properties never prove an item will help.
function L.classify(f)
 if not f or f.owned~=true then return nil,'not_owned' end
 if f.cleanWater==true and (f.thirst or 0)>0 then return 'LootWater','current_thirst' end
 if f.betterDryClothing==true and (f.cold or 0)>0 and f.heat==0 then return 'LootClothing','cold_and_better_dry_layer' end
 if f.inventoryComplete==true and f.workingLight==true and f.dark==true and f.otherWorkingLight==false then return 'LootLight','dark_without_working_light' end
 if f.bandage==true and (f.openWounds or 0)>0 then return 'LootBandage','uncovered_wound' end
 if f.stomachAid==true and (f.foodSickness or 0)>0 then return 'LootStomach','food_sickness' end
 if f.painMedicine==true and (f.pain or 0)>0 then return 'LootPainMedicine','current_pain' end
 if f.edible==true and (f.hunger or 0)>0 then return 'LootFood','current_hunger' end
 if f.inventoryComplete==true then
  if f.neededOpener==true then return 'LootCanOpener','sealed_food_without_opener' end
  if f.neededMagazine==true then return 'LootMagazine','matching_gun_without_magazine' end
  if f.compatibleAmmo==true and type(f.reserve)=='number' and f.reserve<=math.max(20,(f.capacity or 0)*2) then return 'LootAmmo','compatible_low_reserve' end
  if f.usefulWeapon==true then return 'LootWeapon','useful_working_weapon' end
 end
 return nil,'no_verified_need'
end
return L

end

 return 'text:'..(line.text or M.source(line.id)):lower():gsub('[%p%s]+',' ')

function M.stamp(history,line)

end

 if at>0 and now>=at and now-at<M.repeatMs then return true end

 local variant=alternates[line.id]
 local id=M.source(variant and variant.source or line.id)
 if id=='DisinfectDone_1' then return f.outcome~=nil and f.outcome.selfTreatment==true end
 if id=='Bleeding_1' then return f.bleedingCut==true end
 if id:match('^CriticalFading_') then return type(f.health)=='number' and f.health>0 and f.health<=25 end
 if id:match('^CriticalWound_') then return type(f.health)=='number' and f.health>0 and f.health<=25 and ((f.bleeding or 0)>0 or f.acute==true) end

end

R.specialistRoutines={
 CropHarvested={acting="calm",forTraits={GARDENER="Gardener"}},
 FishCaught={acting="relieved",forTraits={FISHING="Angler"}},
 TraitGlasswork={acting="calm",forTraits={ARTISAN="Artisan"}},
 TraitForgeWork={acting="calm",forTraits={BLACKSMITH="Blacksmith Knowledge", BLACKSMITH2="Blacksmith Knowledge"}},
 TraitMasonry={acting="calm",forTraits={MASON="Mason"}},
 TraitWhittling={acting="calm",forTraits={WHITTLER="Whittler"}},
}

local controlledTakes={}
local traitTakes={}
local variantById={}
local coverage=require('CSV/VoiceCoverage').pools
local function addSource(source,id)
 local list=traitTakes[source] or {}
 traitTakes[source]=list
 table.insert(list,id)
end
for id,entry in pairs(require('CSV/VoiceAlternates'))do
 if entry.traitControlled then
  local group=controlledTakes[entry.group] or {normal={},whisper={}}
  controlledTakes[entry.group]=group
  table.insert(group[entry.delivery],id)
 elseif entry.forTraits then
  variantById[id]=entry
  addSource(entry.source,id)
  -- In a sparse pack another approved recording can cover the same meaning.
  -- Wet uses distinct intensities, even within its general coverage pool.
  if entry.group~='Wet' then
   for _,slot in ipairs(coverage[entry.group..'|{}'] or {})do
    local source=entry.delivery=='whisper' and 'Whisper_'..slot or slot
    if source~=entry.source then addSource(source,id) end
   end
  end
 end
end

 local id=group..'_1'
 variantById[id]={group=group,source=id,forTraits=entry.forTraits}
 addSource(id,id)
end

local function qualifies(player,entry,f)
 if entry.traitCondition=='panic' and (f.panic or 0)<3 then return false end
 if entry.traitCondition=='visible' and (f.visible or 0)<1 then return false end
 for key in pairs(entry.forTraits)do
  local constant=CharacterTrait and CharacterTrait[key]
  if constant and require('CSV/Actors').call(player,'hasTrait',constant)==true then return true end
 end

  local expression=V.bank(voice).expressions.catalog[source]

 if g=='TraitFall' and matches(g,t) and f.falling==false then return g end
 if g=='TraitScratch' and matches(g,t) and f.recentCut then return g end
 if g=='TraitIlliterate' and matches(g,t) and f.inspectLiterature then return g end
end

local R={groups={},maxSampleAge=500,contactSettle=250,quietGap=6000}
for _,stem in ipairs({'VehicleCrowd','VehicleSiege','VehicleImpact','VehicleKill'})do
 for _,role in ipairs({'Driver','Passenger'})do R.groups[stem..role]='VehicleDamage' end
end
-- Three occupied quadrants alone can still be a crowd on one side. Require
-- at least four threats and no empty angular half-circle around the vehicle.
function R.surrounded(angles)
 if #angles<4 then return false end
 local sorted={};for i,a in ipairs(angles)do sorted[i]=a end;require('CSV/Sort').sort(sorted)
 local gap=sorted[1]+math.pi*2-sorted[#sorted]
 for i=2,#sorted do gap=math.max(gap,sorted[i]-sorted[i-1])end
 return gap<math.pi
end
function R.contact(a,b,now)
 return a and b and a.alive==true and b.contact==true and b.collision==true
  and (a.contact==false or a.trackedContact==true)
  and a.car==b.car and a.driver~=nil and a.driver==b.driver and b.attacker==b.driver
  and a.weaponRevision==b.weaponRevision and a.burning==false and b.burning==false
  and now>=a.at and now-a.at<=R.maxSampleAge
end
function R.classify(e)
 if not e or e.kind~='vehicle_combat' or e.completed~=true or e.cancelled or e.verified~=true then return nil end
 local role=e.role=='driver' and 'Driver' or e.role=='passenger' and 'Passenger'
 if not role or not e.after or e.after.occupied~=true then return nil end
 if e.event=='crowd' or e.event=='siege' then
  if e.surrounded~=true or (e.targets or 0)<4 then return nil end
  if e.event=='siege' and ((e.panic or 0)<3 or (e.attacks or 0)<1) then return nil end
  return (e.event=='siege' and 'VehicleSiege' or 'VehicleCrowd')..role
 end
 if e.aliveBefore~=true or e.nativeContact~=true or e.driverMatched~=true or e.noInterveningHit~=true then return nil end
 if e.event=='impact' then return 'VehicleImpact'..role end
 if e.event=='kill' and e.dead==true and e.observed==true then return 'VehicleKill'..role end
end
return R

 local bank=V.bank and V.bank(voice).whispers or W

 local item=bank.catalog[line.id];if item and V.clip(voice,item.id) then return item end

 local original=id:match('^Whisper_(.+)$');return original~=nil and W.catalog[original]~=nil
end
return W

for _,region in pairs(regions)do

 W.slots['Bite'..region..'_1']={group='BiteWound',region=region}

-- A wound and a blood stain are independent. Keep the location only when
-- exactly one part meets the condition. Unknown part types stay generic.
function W.readBody(parts,s)
 local wounds,bleeds,bandages,dirty=0,0,0,0
 local bites,bleedingBites=0,0
 local biteRegion,bleedingBiteRegion
 local complete,bitesKnown=true,true
 local woundRegion,bleedRegion,bleedingCut
 for i=0,parts:size()-1 do
  local part=parts:get(i)
  if part:bandaged() then
   bandages=bandages+1
   if part:getBandageLife()<=0 then dirty=dirty+1 end
  end
  local injured=call(part,'HasInjury')
  local bleeding=part:bleeding()
  if injured==nil then complete=false end
  local bitten=call(part,'bitten')
  if bitten==nil then bitesKnown=false end
  if injured or bleeding or bitten then
   local kind=call(part,'getType')
   local region=kind and BodyPartType and regions[BodyPartType.ToString(kind)]
   if bitten then
    bites=bites+1;biteRegion=region
    if bleeding then bleedingBites=bleedingBites+1;bleedingBiteRegion=region end
   end
   if injured then wounds=wounds+1;woundRegion=region end
   if bleeding then
    bleeds=bleeds+1;bleedRegion=region
    if call(part,'isCut')==true then bleedingCut=true end
   end
  end
 end
 s.bandages=bandages;s.dirty=dirty;s.bleeding=bleeds
 s.wounds=complete and wounds or nil
 s.woundRegion=complete and wounds==1 and woundRegion or nil
 s.bleedRegion=bleeds==1 and bleedRegion or nil
 s.bleedingCut=bleedingCut==true
 s.bites=bites;s.bleedingBites=bleedingBites
 s.biteRegion=bitesKnown and bites==1 and biteRegion or nil
 s.bleedingBiteRegion=bitesKnown and bleedingBites==1 and bleedingBiteRegion or nil
end

function W.bloodOnSkin(player)
 local visual=call(player,'getHumanVisual')
 if not visual or not BloodBodyPartType then return false end
 for i=0,BloodBodyPartType.MAX:index()-1 do
  if visual:getBlood(BloodBodyPartType.FromIndex(i))>0 then return true end
 end
 return false
end
return W
